description: This file contains classes and functions for managing and executing a FVP (Fixed Virtual Platform) simulation, including configuration parsing, process control, and telnet interactions.

classes.name: ConsolePortParser
classes.description: Parses console port information from log lines, matching serial connection ports to console identifiers.

classes.name: FVPRunner
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an FVP process, including starting, stopping, and creating telnet and pexpect connections.

methods.name: cli_from_config
methods.description: Constructs a command line argument list for running the FVP based on configuration and terminal choice.

methods.name: check_telnet
methods.description: Checks if the 'telnet' command is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: shlex_join
methods.description: Backported function to join command arguments into a shell-escaped string.
